generation_specification: Eight rear-facing walking poses: left foot push-off, raised passing, reach, contact; then right foot push-off, raised passing, reach, contact. Original three heads, four legs, green/gold scale palette, elevated orthographic pixel rendering, magenta backing. Narrow tail keeps hind feet visible. Targeted correction restored alternating sides and grounded contact phases.
native_review: 60 native frames captured to outputs/Hydra-North-Eight-Native, all eight phase representatives visually inspected against painted board
validation: Native test_hydra_north_walk.gd passes eight unique source cells, timing, loop, pause and reset. No central board integration claimed.
limitations: Broad high hind-leg lift reads as a heavy stomping stride; needs finer intermediates.
Front feet remain mostly obscured by rear silhouette.
Tail tip and hips move more abruptly at phase boundaries than final animation target.
admission: usable first eight-pose rear locomotion Resource for coordinator integration
